messages:
alex (sales): Delta Corp POC is blocked: their strict parser fails intermittently when using function calls + json_mode. They hit it during a 10k-row ingest and trial ends next week.
delta-james (customer): sample raw output (rid_8c7): ```{\"rows\": [{\"id\": \"12\", \"ok\": true}], \"meta\": {\"source\": \"sftp\"}}
Note: two rows had warnings about missing fields```
morgan (solutions): thanks — can you confirm request id and whether you're streaming? any 429s in your logs?
delta-james (customer): req=rid_8c7, using streaming via SDK v2.0. saw spikes:
```
2025-06-02T15:12:01Z WARN req rid_8c7 429 TooManyRequests qps=41 limit=35
2025-06-02T15:12:02Z INFO partial rid_8c7 "{\"rows\": [...]} Some human note"
```
kai (eng-runtime): streaming + json_mode + rate-limit truncation = classic cause. quick mitigations: 1) set header `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` 2) enable `sanitize_trailing_text=true` on the route (trims non-json suffix) 3) add `max_tokens` guard so the model doesn't append long commentary 4) optional: `atomic_response=true` to buffer until the full JSON is produced (or timeout).
rate-bot: Alert: org delta qps spike 2025-06-02T15:12:01Z (41 > 35)
ellie (security): Delta needs 12-month retention and assurance that request bodies with PII won't be stored in plaintext. if we do a Dedicated burst, can logs be redacted?
morgan (solutions): pricing/capacity paths: short-term QPS bump via sales-ops for the trial window OR recommend a Dedicated eval for sustained throughput and contractable retention. sales-ops can provide a temporary uplift quote.
kai (eng-runtime): tech notes: server-side validators can reject responses that don't strictly match the schema; runtime can also truncate trailing tokens automatically. However if customer hits 429 the model sometimes emits a truncated last object (partial JSON) which requires either client retry or atomic buffering to avoid partial returns.
morgan (solutions): recommend runbook: 1) set strict header 2) enable sanitize_trailing_text / atomic_response 3) add client-side: if parse fails and HTTP==200, perform one immediate retry with `prefer_json=true` and exponential jitter 4) if 429s persist, escalate to capacity for temporary QPS increase.
delta-james (customer): applied strict + sanitize locally: parse success rose to ~97%, still see ~3% truncated when we hit 429s. sending new sample rid_8c8.
kai (eng-runtime): please send rid_8c8 logs. if truncation persists we'll enable atomic_response for their route and add server-side post-parse check that returns 502 instead of delivering partial JSON. that prevents bad payloads reaching your parser.
ellie (security): I'll confirm with infra whether Dedicated burst can be configured with body redaction + customer KMS and 12mo retention.
alex (sales): I'll loop in sales-ops and legal; morgan please prepare a short pricing estimate for a 2-week QPS bump vs Dedicated trial and attach the runbook. Delta, thanks for the quick samples — keep them coming and we'll prioritize. :thumbsup:
